main.description: The universal Build Guild primitive: a signed, ternary (yes/no/unknown) opinion about a subject under a named predicate. Endorsements, delivery/payment ratings, votes, and membership are ALL attestations, differing only by predicate + eligibility. Written to the ATTESTER's own atproto repo; it counts only if the attester had standing per the predicate's eligibility rule. Build Guild's D1 only indexes these.

subject.description: Who/what this is about: a DID (a builder or client) or an AT-URI (a guild, proposal, or other record).

value.description: Ternary. yes/no carry signal; unknown is an explicit, dignified abstention.

context.description: Optional strongRef to the anchor that grants standing: the settlement for a delivery rating, the quest for a split rating, the proposal for a vote.

basis.description: For VOTES: the membership HEAD this vote was cast under (the cid of the last roster-changing act seen; the charter at genesis). A vote counts only while it pins the current head — when the roster changes the head advances and old-basis votes are stale by inspection (live-roster governance). See notes/designation-primitive.md §8.

evidence.description: Optional supporting proof an independent auditor can check — e.g. a crypto txid (publicly verifiable), a payment-rail reference, a deliverable URL, or a content hash. The richer the evidence, the more an auditor can trust the claim; un-evidenced payment claims are flagged.
